title: Reinforced Pickaxe
body:
"A powerful blacksteel pickaxe, reinforced with Adurite found deep below the magma caves."

Description

The Reinforced Pickaxe, available exclusively at The Oak Depot, commands a price tag of $44,000 . Renowned as the best purchasable pickaxe in the game.

Appearance

Refined from the finest materials, the Reinforced Pickaxe stands tall, crafted from blacksteel and Adurite. Its headpiece, a fusion of blacksteel and Adurite, bears a resemblance to the Emberbane, yet with a distinct and unique design of its own.

Trivia

  • The Reinforced Pickaxe, alongside its companions in the reinforced tool set, was introduced as part of the highly anticipated Progression Update.
  • When introduced its original price was $266,000
